title: FAIRFIL: CONTRASTIVE NEURAL DEBIASING METHOD FOR PRETRAINED TEXT ENCODERS

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to measure the effect size of cosine similarities between sentence embeddings of gendered target words (e.g., male/female names and terms) and attribute words (e.g., career vs. family, math vs. arts, science vs. arts) placed within semantically bleached sentence templates.
